title: Fern and the Moonlit Forest Mystery

request.prompt: Arun finds an old camera in his grandfather’s room. When he takes a photo with it, the picture shows something that will happen tomorrow. At first, he uses it for fun. But one day, the camera shows a picture of his best friend in danger. Arun has only 24 hours to discover where the picture was taken and prevent what he saw.
